title: 第3章 信使的秘密第4章 离开白峰城
lines: 风沙刮过废墟的呼啸声，隔着厚厚的土层传进来，闷闷的，好像很远，就像一头巨兽趴在那儿喘气，一声接一声，碾过白峰城这片荒凉的土地。
防空洞里，那片银色的光并没有到处乱涌，只是安安稳稳地罩住一小块地方。十字徽章浮在陆寻手心上方一点点，静静悬着，光很干净，持续净化着洞里残留的辐射浊气。原本常年冰冷刺骨的地下空间，温度慢慢升了上来，不再有种钻进骨头里的阴寒。
陆寻抬手，用手指轻轻碰了碰浮着的徽章。
温热的，稳定的，带着一种强烈的秩序感。
和这片废土上常年弥漫的混乱、暴戾、还有被辐射侵蚀的那种无序能量，完全是两码事。
他握起手掌，徽章稳稳落回掌心，周围的异象也跟着消失了。所有光芒瞬间缩回铜质的纹路里，又变回一枚看起来普普通通的旧徽章，只有留下的那点温热，真切地提醒着他，刚才发生的不是幻觉。
宿命从来不是嘴上说说，是真真切切压在肩膀上的千斤重担。
林小满站在旁边，她的感知一直向外铺开着。她能清楚地捕捉到洞外风沙流动的痕迹、远处废墟里几只变异老鼠的微弱动静，整片区域的危险信号都很平常。唯独陆寻身上那股收敛着的古老能量，深得像海，根本看不透。
“外面安全。”她低声说，语气平稳，“没有高级别的异常动静，也没有盗匪在附近窥探，今晚可以休息。”
陆寻点点头，把徽章重新贴胸口收好，麻绳绕过脖子，稳稳地垂在衣服里面。贴身放着，既是保护这唯一的宿命信物，也是守住眼下这份难得的安稳能量。
他又拿起那封泛黄的信纸。
刚才匆匆扫了一眼，他只明白了“轮回”和“信使”的核心意思，可信纸末尾空白处那些细小的字迹、一层层隐藏起来的秘密信息，他还没来得及细看。祖父用一辈子等待传承，临死前留下的文字，藏着一百年来灾变最残酷、最完整的真相。
煤油灯的火苗稳定下来，不再晃动了。
陆寻把信纸平铺在粗糙的石台上，手指轻轻抚过已经发脆的纸边，动作小心极了，生怕稍微用点力，就把这跨越了一百年的真相记录给弄碎了。
字句慢慢映入眼帘，一段被旧时代彻底掩盖、被百年轮回反复封存的秘密，缓缓铺开。
一百年前，并不是天塌地陷、星辰坠落的末日天灾。
那时候的人类文明，早已进入意识科研的时代，物质文明高度发达，却面临着地球资源枯竭、生态彻底崩溃的绝境。为了延续人类的火种，一群顶尖科学家聚集起来，启动了一项叫做“归墟”的终极救世实验。
实验的初衷非常纯粹：舍弃这个破败的物质世界，把全人类的意识从身体里剥离出来，转移到一个已经构建好的虚拟精神领域里。用这个办法，来避开地球毁灭的命运，让人类文明永远延续下去。
这是人类最后的自救，也是最疯狂的一场豪赌。
可是人心难控，规则难束。
实验到了最后阶段，主导的人偏执失控，强行篡改了核心程序，想把这个精神领域改造成可以控制的牢笼，剥夺所有人的自主意识，打造一个完全由自己掌控、绝对秩序的新世界。程序瞬间崩溃，意识的洪流失控爆发，维度之间的壁垒被强行撕开，现实世界和精神领域彻底混乱地交融在一起。
没有惊天动地的爆炸，没有山崩地裂的灾难。
世界只是悄无声息地卡住、重置、倒转。
时间轴被硬生生锁死在一百年前实验失控的那一天。四季轮回停止了，岁月不再向前，所有的灾变创伤、辐射污染、生灵死亡，每到一百年的那个节点，都会被悄悄重置。死去的人会再次活过来，倒塌的废墟会再次出现，肆虐的变异兽会再次繁衍。人类永远困在这片残破的大地上，重复着挣扎、求生、死亡的悲剧。
世人眼里看到的常态，是永恒的荒芜废土。
可真相是，这个世界早就死了，如今存在的一切，只是一场无限循环的虚假倒影。
读到这里，陆寻的手指猛地攥紧。
纸页被捏出了褶皱，他胸口涌起一阵冰冷的窒息感。
他终于明白了，为什么废土之上永远看不到文明复苏的痕迹，为什么不管人类怎么挣扎求生、开垦建设，最后都会变回荒芜。所有人的努力、坚守、抗争，从头到尾，都只是在既定的轮回剧本里徒劳地打转。
一代代人求生、死亡、重生，没人知道自己只是轮回里的一粒尘埃。
只有信使，是唯一的变数。
信里写着，信使这一脉，是维度壁垒错乱之后，自然诞生的特殊传承。他们不受轮回重置的影响，保留着完整的记忆和使命，一代代传下来，只为了等待一个能彻底打破局面的时机。
祖父是上一代信使。
他亲身经历过轮回的倒转，目睹过无数次希望破灭、文明归零的绝望。他用尽一生走遍东大陆，寻找破局的方法，最终却受困于辐射绝症和时代的局限，无力撼动早已固化的轮回规则，只能把未完成的使命、所有的真相，封存在这一纸遗言里，静静等待下一代的传承者到来。
陆寻是新一代，也是到目前为止，最有可能打破轮回的信使。
“无限轮回……”
陆寻低声重复着这四个字，嗓音低沉沙哑，带着一丝难以置信的沉重。
十几年来的人生瞬间被彻底颠覆。他过去的隐忍、求生、对安稳日子的盼望，在这场宏大又荒诞的轮回骗局里，显得格外渺小可笑。
原来他和林小满拼死守住的那一点点安稳，不过是轮回剧本里，眨眼就过的固定片段。
只要轮回不停止，这场苦难就永远不会结束。
“所以，我们经历的一切，都会重来一遍？”林小满轻柔的声音在旁边响起，带着一丝不易察觉的凉意。
她没有看信纸，却从陆寻的神色和气息波动里，拼凑出了全部的真相。她的精神感知异常敏锐，能清晰地感受到天地间那股无形的束缚力，温和却又霸道，牢牢地禁锢着世间所有生灵，不让任何人挣脱既定的命运。
陆寻缓缓摇头，目光死死盯在信纸最后那几行字上，沉声道：“不是所有人。”
“信使不受轮回重置的影响。”
“还有你。”
content_en:
The whistling sound of wind and sand blowing through the ruins came through the thick soil. It was muffled and seemed very far away, like a giant beast lying there panting, rolling over the desolate land of Baifeng City with one sound after another.
In the air-raid shelter, the silver light did not flow everywhere, but only covered a small area safely. The cross badge floated a little above the palm of Lu Xun's hand, hanging quietly. The light was very clean, and it continued to purify the remaining radioactive odor in the cave. The temperature of the underground space, which had been bone-chilling all year round, slowly rose, and there was no longer a chill that penetrated into the bones.
Lu Xun raised his hand and lightly touched the floating badge with his finger.
Warm, stable, with a strong sense of order.
It is completely different from the chaos, violence, and disordered energy that has been eroded by radiation all year round in this wasteland.
He held his palm, the badge fell steadily back into his palm, and the surrounding phenomena also disappeared. All the light instantly retracted into the copper lines and turned back into an ordinary-looking old badge. Only the warmth left behind truly reminded him that what just happened was not an illusion.
Fate is never just a word, it is a real heavy burden on your shoulders.
Lin Xiaoman stood nearby, her perception spreading outward. She could clearly capture the traces of sand flowing outside the cave, the faint movement of a few mutated rats in the ruins in the distance, and the danger signals in the entire area were normal. Only the concentrated ancient energy in Lu Xun's body was as deep as the sea and could not be seen through at all.
"It's safe outside." She whispered in a steady tone, "There are no high-level unusual movements, and there are no bandits snooping around. You can rest tonight."
Lu Xun nodded, put the badge back on his chest and put it away. The hemp rope was wrapped around his neck and hung steadily inside his clothes. Keeping it close to your body is not only to protect this only token of destiny, but also to preserve this rare and stable energy.
He picked up the yellowed letter again.
After a quick glance just now, he only understood the core meaning of "reincarnation" and "messenger". He hadn't had time to take a closer look at the small handwriting and the secret information hidden layer by layer in the blank space at the end of the trustworthy paper. My grandfather spent his whole life waiting for the inheritance, and the words he left before his death contained the cruelest and most complete truth about the disaster in the past hundred years.
The flame of the kerosene lamp stabilized and stopped shaking.
Lu Xun laid the letter paper flat on the rough stone platform, and gently stroked the brittle edge of the paper with his fingers. He was very careful, fearing that with just a little force, the record of the truth that spanned a hundred years would be shattered.
The words slowly came into view, and a secret that was completely covered up by the old era and sealed repeatedly by hundreds of years of reincarnation slowly unfolded.
A hundred years ago, it was not an apocalyptic natural disaster in which the sky fell, the earth fell, and the stars fell.
At that time, human civilization had already entered the era of scientific research on consciousness. Material civilization was highly developed, but it was facing the desperate situation of depletion of earth's resources and complete ecological collapse. In order to continue the human fire, a group of top scientists gathered together and launched an ultimate salvation experiment called "Return to Ruins".
The original intention of the experiment is very pure: to abandon this dilapidated material world, separate the consciousness of all mankind from the body, and transfer it to a virtual spiritual realm that has been constructed. Use this method to avoid the fate of the earth's destruction and allow human civilization to continue forever.
This is humanity's last attempt to save itself, and it is also the craziest gamble.
But people's hearts are hard to control, and rules are hard to enforce.
When the experiment reached the final stage, the leader lost control of his paranoia and forcibly tampered with the core program. He wanted to transform this spiritual realm into a controllable cage, deprive everyone of their sense of autonomy, and create a new world completely controlled by themselves and of absolute order. The program collapsed instantly, the torrent of consciousness erupted out of control, the barriers between dimensions were forcibly torn apart, and the real world and the spiritual realm blended together in complete chaos.
There were no earth-shattering explosions, no landslides and earth-shattering disasters.
The world just silently gets stuck, resets, and turns upside down.
The timeline is locked to the day when the experiment went out of control a hundred years ago. The cycle of seasons has stopped, and time no longer moves forward. All disasters, trauma, radiation pollution, and death of living creatures will be quietly reset every hundred years. The dead will come to life again, the collapsed ruins will appear again, and the raging mutant beasts will reproduce again. Human beings are forever trapped in this broken land, repeating the tragedy of struggle, survival, and death.
What the world sees as normality is an eternal barren wasteland.
But the truth is that this world has died long ago, and everything that exists now is just an infinite loop of false reflections.
After reading this, Lu Xun's fingers clenched tightly.
The pages were wrinkled, and a cold suffocating feeling surged in his chest.
He finally understood why there would never be traces of the recovery of civilization in the wasteland, and why no matter how hard humans struggled to survive and cultivate and build, they would eventually turn back to desolation. Everyone's efforts, perseverance, and resistance, from beginning to end, are just spinning in vain within the established reincarnation script.
Generations of people survive, die, and are reborn, and no one knows that they are just a speck of dust in reincarnation.
Only the messenger is the only variable.
The letter states that the messenger lineage is a special inheritance that was born naturally after the dimensional barrier was disrupted. They are not affected by the reset of reincarnation and retain their complete memories and missions, which are passed down from generation to generation, just waiting for an opportunity to completely break the situation.
Grandfather was a messenger from the previous generation.
He has personally experienced the reversal of reincarnation and witnessed countless times of despair when hope is shattered and civilization returns to zero. He spent his whole life traveling around the Eastern Continent, looking for a way to break the situation. In the end, he was trapped by the terminal illness of radiation and the limitations of the times. He was unable to shake the long-established rules of reincarnation. He could only seal the unfinished mission and all the truth in this will and quietly wait for the arrival of the next generation of inheritors.
Lu Xun is the new generation and by far the most likely messenger to break the cycle of reincarnation.
"Infinite reincarnation..."
Lu Xun repeated these four words in a low voice, his voice low and hoarse, with a hint of incredible heaviness.
The life of more than ten years was completely overturned in an instant. His past forbearance, survival, and hope for a stable life seemed extremely small and ridiculous in this grand and absurd reincarnation scam.
It turns out that the little bit of stability that he and Lin Xiaoman fought so hard to hold on to was just a fixed episode in the reincarnation script that passed by in the blink of an eye.
As long as reincarnation does not stop, this suffering will never end.
"So, everything we experienced will happen again?" Lin Xiaoman's soft voice sounded next to him, with a hint of coolness that was imperceptible.
She didn't read the letter, but she pieced together the whole truth from Lu Xun's expression and aura fluctuations. Her mental perception is extremely sharp, and she can clearly feel the invisible binding force between heaven and earth, which is gentle but domineering, firmly imprisoning all living beings in the world, and preventing anyone from breaking away from their destined destiny.
Lu Xun slowly shook his head, his eyes fixed on the last few lines of the letter, and said solemnly: "Not everyone."
"The Messenger is not affected by the reincarnation reset."
"And you."
title_en: Chapter 3 The Secret of the Messenger Chapter 4 Leaving Baifeng City
